arg.name: map_path
arg.description: Autoware map directory; its name is the CARLA level unless carla_map is set

arg.name: carla_map
arg.description: CARLA level to load; empty uses the name of map_path, and keeps the current level when both are empty

arg.name: sync_mode
arg.description: Synchronous mode, ticked by this node (the only client allowed to tick)

arg.name: fixed_delta_seconds
arg.description: Simulation step [s]; CARLA's Autoware launcher validates 0.05 (20 Hz)

arg.name: time_scale
arg.description: Simulation speed relative to wall time

arg.name: no_rendering_mode
arg.description: Disable rendering; cameras are then not spawned (a -nullrhi server crashes on them)

arg.name: vehicle_blueprint
arg.description: Empty uses the vehicle of the sensor kit file

arg.name: spawn_point
arg.description: x,y,z,roll,pitch,yaw in CARLA coordinates (m, deg); empty uses spawn_index

arg.name: spawn_index
arg.description: Index into the level's ego spawn points; negative picks one at random

arg.name: map_origin_x
arg.description: CARLA world origin in the Autoware map frame (x)

arg.name: map_origin_y
arg.description: CARLA world origin in the Autoware map frame (y)

arg.name: traffic_light.publish
arg.description: Publish CARLA's traffic-light states on Autoware's external traffic-signal input

arg.name: traffic_light.map_path
arg.description: lanelet2 map used to match CARLA lights to regulatory elements; empty uses the OpenDRIVE signal id
